items.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. One square painterly bestiary illustration of Dahu, an Alpine chamois-like goat-antelope with two small curved horns. Exactly FOUR legs, but the animal's TWO LEFT-SIDE LEGS are conspicuously SHORTER than its TWO RIGHT-SIDE LEGS. View from FRONT THREE-QUARTER: animal facing toward viewer and slightly to image-left, show chest and both sides clearly. Its anatomical LEFT side is on the RIGHT of this frontal image and UPHILL on the steep slope; those two legs are very short. Its anatomical RIGHT side is on the LEFT of image and DOWNHILL; those two legs are long. The terrain rises to image-right. All four hooves contact the hillside and torso remains approximately level. Keep every leg visible with no overlaps. Beautiful Alpine hillside, believable fur and anatomy, copper sunset forest-green palette, no wings, no extra legs, no text, no diagrams, no labels, no watermark.

Use case: scientific-educational. One square painterly mythology encyclopedia illustration of Fuzhu, a natural deerlike Chinese beast beside a flooded river plain. Exactly FOUR DISTINCT HORNS rising from FOUR SEPARATE ROOTS on its head, arranged as two pairs: a shorter front pair and a taller rear pair. Spread the four thin curved unbranched antler-like horns apart with clear sky visible between every horn, show all four roots; no branching that can be confused with extra horns, never three horns. Front three-quarter view, full natural four-legged deer body and deer tail. Horns occupy upper center with comfortable margins. Detailed painterly copper and forest-green folklore book illustration, no wings, no text or watermark.

Use case: scientific-educational. One square painterly illustrated Lake Baikal folklore portrait of Alara, a small girl-like fairy in a modest opaque historical dress with human arms and legs, beside cold clear lake waters. Exactly TWO luminous butterfly-like WINGS TOTAL: one single undivided oval butterfly wing on her LEFT and one single undivided oval butterfly wing on her RIGHT. Each wing is a simple elongated unlobed oval membrane with beautiful butterfly vein patterns. No lower wing lobes, no separate hindwings, no second pair. Show both entire wings with comfortable space, front three-quarter view. Peaceful woodland lake and copper forest-green light, no text, no border, no watermark.
